prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. New wordless comic panel immediately after image 1: the great golden castle door slowly creaks open, and the SAME FIVE friends WALK INSIDE, finding it DARK. Convey creaking through the heavy angled open door and cautious movement only, NO written sound effect. Wide 16:9 polished soft glossy 3D fantasy animation matching this project's illustrations.
View from INSIDE the unlit entrance hall at an oblique angle: tall star-medallion golden double doors at left background swung inward, bright pastel terrace and purple starry space seen through gap. Five friends crossing threshold moving toward right into the dim hall. Odette takes first cautious step, others close beside and behind, faces visible three-quarter to camera with curious mildly surprised expressions. Exactly FIVE: Odette, Aurora, Eclipse, round pink Kirby, turquoise long-eared friend. No Dingdong, no extra characters or lurking figures.
Image1 is scene/outfit continuity. Image2 is canonical Odette, preserve brown hair, lavender clip, bright blue eyes, yellow spacesuit, cat-ear yellow helmet with bow and pink/mint ears, clear closed bubble visor, white belly pink bow gem, yellow gloves boots, PINK-WHITE ROCKETS STRAPPED TO BACK. Images3 and4 are canonical Aurora and Eclipse identity references: preserve Aurora's pink/rainbow hair, purple eyes and forehead golden star/white curls; Eclipse lavender skin and hair, central curl, purple eyes and starry dark hair accents. They continue wearing the same YELLOW SPACESUITS and helmets/back rocket packs as image1 because this is their established space adventure; do not revert to dresses, crowns, wings or hand props from their portrait references. Rockets off, walking with feet on floor.
Pink friend unchanged round pink simple body, tall blue-black eyes rosy cheeks little arms red feet. Image5 authoritative turquoise friend design: UPRIGHT slender biped, small torso, two little arms near chest, TWO long oval feet; large oval blue sparkle eyes, tiny mouth, pink cheeks. TWO HUGE FLOWING TURQUOISE EARS with CORAL ORANGE interiors, each rises well above head and cascades down to near feet with tapered outward curling tips, NOT short round mouse ears. LONG THICK sweeping turquoise tapered tail fully visible. Match corrected design image1, no quadruped paws. No clothes on either planet friend.
DARKNESS is essential: right two-thirds of hall in deep midnight blue/violet shadow, mostly unlit, only faint shapes of tall columns/arches disappearing into darkness, no illuminated chandeliers, no lit magical gems or bright interior windows. Exterior doorway casts one warm wedge of light across floor and rim lights friends, subdued reflected light just enough to read all five faces/designs. Long soft shadows ahead of them, dim marble reflections, mysterious but gentle child-friendly mood. Preserve pastel-gold architecture in shadow. No invented threat, monster, host, surprise or revealed room contents. All five fully in frame, no duplication. No text, captions, typography, speech bubbles, sound-effect lettering, watermark or border.
